//DrySpellReset: Keeps GameStat/hw_stat_dryspell a CONSECUTIVE dry counter (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/events_stats.md section 3b, the drought DECISION): on every tick it rains it sets the counter back to 0 (ValueModifier -1344, the counter's max, so any value lands on its floor of 0). The precedent for a counter reset by a self-triggered action is vanilla Tgr_MoonPhaseReset. ALL GATES ARE StatChangeTrigger ENTRIES, never RequiredStatValues: an unresolved trigger stat never fires (fails closed) while an unresolved RequiredStatValues stat is skipped (fails open), events_stats.md section 0. Gate 1, hw_switch_drought {1,1}: with the [Threats] Drought switch off nothing here runs (the counter then just climbs to its cap, read by nothing). Gate 2, vanilla RainValue (773fb34e869224f499d43b441c973c62) {1,5}: any rain, Drizzle 1 to Torrential 5, which vanilla's weather cards write; 0 is the No Rain status that feeds vanilla NoRainCounter. RepeatOptions 0 (Repeat) with OncePerTick and no cooldown: GameManager.CheckAllStatsForActions re-derives every listened condition on every tick, so this fires once per rainy tick (MEASURED from .decomp/GameManager.cs and StatTriggeredActionStatus.UpdateReadyToPlay). It writes only our own hidden counter, never a vanilla stat.
